lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are visible in a sparse grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill slits, primarily concentrated in the mid-lateral flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is detectable on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance dorsally to a shadowed gradient ventrally.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots across its entire visible dorsal surface.
